# FitFile full tool reference

## Resize Image to KB
URL: https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/resize-image-to-kb/
What it does: Make a photo smaller than a size limit, like 50 KB.
Input: a file chosen in the browser (cannot be passed by URL)
Fields: max (number), min (number), fmt (select), w (number), h (number), mode (select)

## Compress Image
URL: https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/compress-image/
What it does: Shrink JPG, PNG or WebP with a quality slider.
Input: a file chosen in the browser (cannot be passed by URL)
Fields: q (range), fmt (select)

## Resize Image
URL: https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/resize-image/
What it does: Change width and height in pixels or percent.
Input: a file chosen in the browser (cannot be passed by URL)
Fields: by (select), fmt (select), w (number), h (number), pct (number), lock (checkbox)

## Convert Image Format
URL: https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/convert-image/
What it does: Convert between JPG, PNG and WebP.
Input: a file chosen in the browser (cannot be passed by URL)
Fields: fmt (select), q (range)

## HEIC to JPG
URL: https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/heic-to-jpg/
What it does: Convert iPhone HEIC photos to JPG.
Input: a file chosen in the browser (cannot be passed by URL)
Fields: q (range)

## Rotate & Flip Image
URL: https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/rotate-flip-image/
What it does: Rotate 90° or flip an image.
Input: a file chosen in the browser (cannot be passed by URL)
Fields: rot (select), flip (select)

## Remove Photo Metadata (EXIF)
URL: https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/remove-image-metadata/
What it does: Strip location and camera data from a photo.
Input: a file chosen in the browser (cannot be passed by URL)
Fields: fmt (select)

## Add Watermark to Image
URL: https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/add-watermark-to-image/
What it does: Put your own text watermark on a photo.
Input: a file chosen in the browser (cannot be passed by URL)
Fields: txt (text), pos (select), sz (range), op (range), col (color)

## Image to Base64
URL: https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/image-to-base64/
What it does: Turn an image into a Base64 data URL.
Input: a file chosen in the browser (cannot be passed by URL)
Fields: none

## Passport Photo Maker
URL: https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/passport-photo-maker/
What it does: Crop a photo to passport size and print sheet.
Input: a file chosen in the browser (cannot be passed by URL)
Fields: pre (select), outmode (select), mw (number), mh (number), zoom (range), ox (range), oy (range)

## Signature Cleaner
URL: https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/signature-cleaner/
What it does: Make a photo of your signature transparent.
Input: a file chosen in the browser (cannot be passed by URL)
Fields: th (range), mode (select)

## Image Colour Picker
URL: https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/image-color-picker/
What it does: Click a photo to get its HEX and RGB colour.
Input: a file chosen in the browser (cannot be passed by URL)
Fields: none

## Compress PDF
URL: https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/compress-pdf/
What it does: Shrink a PDF under a size limit like 200 KB.
Input: a file chosen in the browser (cannot be passed by URL)
Fields: max (number), gray (checkbox)

## Merge PDF
URL: https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/merge-pdf/
What it does: Join several PDFs into one, in your order.
Input: a file chosen in the browser (cannot be passed by URL)
Fields: none

## Split PDF / Extract Pages
URL: https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/split-pdf/
What it does: Keep only the pages you pick.
Input: a file chosen in the browser (cannot be passed by URL)
Fields: pages (text)

## Remove Pages from PDF
URL: https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/remove-pdf-pages/
What it does: Delete unwanted pages from a PDF.
Input: a file chosen in the browser (cannot be passed by URL)
Fields: pages (text)

## Image to PDF
URL: https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/image-to-pdf/
What it does: Turn photos into one PDF, with optional size limit.
Input: a file chosen in the browser (cannot be passed by URL)
Fields: page (select), max (number)

## JPG to PDF
URL: https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/jpg-to-pdf/
What it does: Turn photos into one PDF, with optional size limit.
Input: a file chosen in the browser (cannot be passed by URL)
Fields: page (select), max (number)

## PDF to JPG
URL: https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/pdf-to-jpg/
What it does: Turn every PDF page into a JPG image.
Input: a file chosen in the browser (cannot be passed by URL)
Fields: fmt (select), sc (select)

## Rotate PDF
URL: https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/rotate-pdf/
What it does: Rotate all or some pages of a PDF.
Input: a file chosen in the browser (cannot be passed by URL)
Fields: deg (select), pages (text)

## Add Page Numbers to PDF
URL: https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/add-page-numbers-to-pdf/
What it does: Number every page of a PDF.
Input: a file chosen in the browser (cannot be passed by URL)
Fields: pos (select), fmt (select), start (number), size (number)

## Add Watermark to PDF
URL: https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/pdf-watermark/
What it does: Stamp text across every page.
Input: a file chosen in the browser (cannot be passed by URL)
Fields: txt (text), op (range)

## PDF to Text
URL: https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/pdf-to-text/
What it does: Copy the text out of a PDF.
Input: a file chosen in the browser (cannot be passed by URL)
Fields: none

## EMI Calculator
URL: https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/emi-calculator/
What it does: Monthly EMI, total interest and payoff for any loan.
Input: URL parameters
Fields: principal (number), rate (number), years (number), unit (select)

## SIP Calculator
URL: https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/sip-calculator/
What it does: Future value of a monthly SIP at an expected return.
Input: URL parameters
Fields: amt (number), rate (number), years (number)

## Compound Interest Calculator
URL: https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/compound-interest-calculator/
What it does: Growth of a lump sum with compounding.
Input: URL parameters
Fields: p (number), rate (number), years (number), freq (select)

## Simple Interest Calculator
URL: https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/simple-interest-calculator/
What it does: Interest = P × R × T ÷ 100.
Input: URL parameters
Fields: p (number), rate (number), years (number)

## FD Calculator
URL: https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/fd-calculator/
What it does: Fixed deposit maturity amount.
Input: URL parameters
Fields: p (number), rate (number), years (number), freq (select)

## CAGR Calculator
URL: https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/cagr-calculator/
What it does: Compound annual growth rate between two values.
Input: URL parameters
Fields: s (number), e (number), years (number)

## GST Calculator
URL: https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/gst-calculator/
What it does: Add or remove GST, with the current India slabs.
Input: URL parameters
Fields: amt (number), rate (number), mode (select)

## Percentage Calculator
URL: https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/percentage-calculator/
What it does: X% of Y, what percent, and percent change.
Input: URL parameters
Fields: a (number), b (number)

## Discount Calculator
URL: https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/discount-calculator/
What it does: Final price after a percentage discount.
Input: URL parameters
Fields: price (number), off (number), off2 (number)

## Tip & Bill Split Calculator
URL: https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/tip-calculator/
What it does: Tip and split a bill between people.
Input: URL parameters
Fields: bill (number), tip (number), ppl (number)

## In-Hand Salary Calculator
URL: https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/in-hand-salary-calculator/
What it does: Take-home pay under new and old tax regime, FY 2026-27.
Input: URL parameters
Fields: gross (number), basic (number), pt (number), c80 (number), d80 (number), oth (number), pfcap (checkbox)

## Gratuity Calculator
URL: https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/gratuity-calculator/
What it does: Gratuity from last salary and years of service.
Input: URL parameters
Fields: b (number), y (number), m (number)

## HRA Exemption Calculator
URL: https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/hra-exemption-calculator/
What it does: Tax-free HRA under the old regime.
Input: URL parameters
Fields: b (number), h (number), r (number), c (select)

## GSTIN Validator
URL: https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/gstin-validator/
What it does: Check a GST number format, state and checksum.
Input: URL parameters
Fields: g (text)

## PAN Format Checker
URL: https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/pan-validator/
What it does: Check PAN structure and holder type.
Input: URL parameters
Fields: p (text)

## Rent Receipt Generator
URL: https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/rent-receipt-generator/
What it does: Monthly rent receipts as a PDF, for HRA claims.
Input: URL parameters
Fields: tenant (text), landlord (text), lpan (text), rent (number), addr (text), sm (select), sy (number), cnt (number), mode (select)

## Invoice Generator
URL: https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/invoice-generator/
What it does: Create a clean invoice PDF, with optional GST.
Input: URL parameters
Fields: from (text), fgst (text), to (text), inv (text), date (date), gst (number), items (textarea), notes (textarea)

## QR Code Generator
URL: https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/qr-code-generator/
What it does: QR for links, Wi-Fi, UPI, WhatsApp, email and more.
Input: URL parameters
Fields: type (select), text (textarea), ssid (text), wpass (text), wsec (select), upi (text), upn (text), upa (number), wan (text), wam (text), ema (text), ems (text), tel (text), ecl (select)

## Barcode Generator
URL: https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/barcode-generator/
What it does: Code 128, EAN-13, UPC and more as PNG.
Input: URL parameters
Fields: val (text), fmt (select), txt (checkbox)

## QR Code Reader
URL: https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/qr-code-reader/
What it does: Read a QR code from a photo or screenshot.
Input: a file chosen in the browser (cannot be passed by URL)
Fields: none

## Random Number Generator
URL: https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/random-number-generator/
What it does: Random numbers in a range, with or without repeats.
Input: URL parameters
Fields: min (number), max (number), cnt (number), uniq (checkbox)

## Coin Flip & Dice Roller
URL: https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/coin-flip-and-dice/
What it does: Flip a coin or roll dice.
Input: URL parameters
Fields: nd (number), sides (select)

## Random Name Picker
URL: https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/random-name-picker/
What it does: Pick winners or make random teams from a list.
Input: URL parameters
Fields: names (textarea), mode (select), n (number)

## Online Stopwatch
URL: https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/online-stopwatch/
What it does: Stopwatch with laps.
Input: URL parameters
Fields: none

## Countdown Timer
URL: https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/countdown-timer/
What it does: Countdown with a sound alert.
Input: URL parameters
Fields: h (number), m (number), s (number)

## Online Notepad
URL: https://pritam-4560.github.io/freekit/tools/online-notepad/
What it does: A private notepad that saves in your browser.
Input: URL parameters
Fields: pad (textarea)
